goal: Include locally submitted unbroadcast transactions in mempool memory calculations so that memory limits and reporting account for them accurately.
agreement: Strong support with code verification and test confirmation (jeanpablojp).

categories.name: mempool
why: P4 because the unaccounted memory is limited to locally submitted unbroadcast transactions, typically totaling only a few hundred bytes.
It fixes an accounting omission in DynamicMemoryUsage without changing policy, eviction behavior, or relay performance.

result.summary: This pull request adds `memusage::DynamicUsage(m_unbroadcast_txids)` to `CTxMemPool::DynamicMemoryUsage()`. It also adds a unit test in `src/test/mempool_tests.cpp` asserting that adding and removing a transaction from the unbroadcast set correctly updates reported memory usage.
result.problem: `CTxMemPool::DynamicMemoryUsage()` omits the `m_unbroadcast_txids` set when calculating retained memory, causing `getmempoolinfo` and `-maxmempool` limits to slightly undercount memory used by locally submitted transactions awaiting initial broadcast.

reviewability.label: Ready

categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Modifies CTxMemPool dynamic memory accounting in src/txmempool.cpp.
categories.rationale: The PR fixes a minor memory accounting omission for locally submitted unbroadcast transactions. Because m_unbroadcast_txids only tracks locally submitted transactions awaiting their first broadcast, its memory footprint is negligible (around 80 bytes per entry) compared to total mempool usage, making the practical impact minimal.

result.card: This PR adds memory tracking for the `m_unbroadcast_txids` set to `CTxMemPool::DynamicMemoryUsage()` alongside a unit test. It ensures `getmempoolinfo` and `-maxmempool` account for the overhead of locally submitted transactions awaiting broadcast. The practical impact is marginal because the unbroadcast set is small and local-only. Review is ready, with tested support from jeanpablojp and no open objections.
